t: What Algae Biofuel Refining Systems Is
title: What Algae Biofuel Refining Systems Is
provenance: Public research knowledge: documented developments, published research, and established technical references. Real, fact-checked records.
description: Algae biofuel refining grows oil-rich microalgae in ponds or photobioreactors, then extracts and refines the oils into diesel, jet fuel, and chemicals — fuel from sunlight and CO2, on non-arable land, without competing with food. This record is the entry point of the teaching ladder for Algae Biofuel Refining Systems: start here, then move through the research state, the specifications, the public developments, the open challenges, and finally each piece needed to build it.
key_points: Algae Biofuel Refining Systems in one line: Algae biofuel refining grows oil-rich microalgae in ponds or photobioreactors, then extracts and refines the oils into diesel, jet fuel, and chemicals — fuel from sunlight and CO2, on non-arable land, without competing with food.
Why it matters: Algae yields 10-100x more oil per acre than crops: biofuel without the food fight..
Where it is used: sustainable aviation fuel, renewable diesel, bioplastics, animal feed (co-product)..
Ladder rank 1 — the foundation. Everything else builds on this.

t: Current Research State of Algae Biofuel Refining Systems
